title: Kitchen Sink Runtime Example
description: Standalone kitchen sink workspace under examples/kitchen-sink. Starts a local DSAR runtime with SQLite persistence + filesystem storage and runs a broad API walkthrough covering core lifecycle and integration surfaces.
features: runtime.config.ts - DSAR runtime config (filesystem storage adapter)
server.ts - local Node HTTP server hosting dsarInstance(...)
quickStart:
1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`.
2. Start the runtime:

```sh
turbo run dev --filter=dsar-kitchen-sink-example
```

3. In another terminal, run the kitchen sink walkthrough:

```sh
turbo run kitchen-sink --filter=dsar-kitchen-sink-example
```
usage: Uses defaults: PORT=3021, .dsar-kitchen-sink.db, .dsar-kitchen-sink-artifacts. Runtime config wires @dsar/inbound-resend and @dsar/outbound-resend; outbound resend runs in mock-delivery mode (DSAR_OUTBOUND_RESEND_LIVE=false) by default. smoke and kitchen-sink run the same walkthrough script. Intended for local development and exploration.
